service.description: A payroll exchange read and each row resolved, nothing made (PayrollExchange's Exchange step). exchangeKind export (PAYROLL_VIEW and PAYROLL_EDIT): a pay group's prepared period's approved inputs, each with its source key (NOTHING_TO_EXPORT, TOO_MANY_ROWS past 2000; an input of an employment the group does not pay then is refused NOT_IN_GROUP); history (PEOPLE_IMPORT, PAYROLL_VIEW, PAYROLL_EDIT): an employer's file of pay records (worker, payDate, gross, net, currency) before the cutover day, each resolved to the employment of that day and refused WORKER_UNKNOWN, WORKER_AMBIGUOUS, DATE_INVALID, AFTER_CUTOVER, AMOUNT_INVALID, CURRENCY_INVALID, NOT_EMPLOYED, EMPLOYMENT_AMBIGUOUS, PAID_HERE (a day People paid) or CONFLICT (the day's record has other amounts), or known (recorded already) or duplicate; results (the same permissions): a group in external processing's period's lines (worker, component, amount), with the employees, net and gross the processor signed off (SIGNOFF_REQUIRED), each refused WORKER_UNKNOWN, NOT_IN_GROUP, COMPONENT_UNKNOWN (no published term on the pay date), AMOUNT_INVALID, CURRENCY_MISMATCH or LINE_REPEATED, an employee with a refused line refused whole (EMPLOYEE_INCOMPLETE), with a negative net (NEGATIVE_NET) or paid already (ALREADY_PAID), one in the period's run already known. A file (or for an export the same inputs) seen already for the scope answers its batch (repeated). Refuses: KIND_INVALID, PERMISSION_DENIED, GROUP_REQUIRED, RECORD_UNAVAILABLE, PERIOD_UNAVAILABLE, NOT_EXTERNAL, ORGANIZATION_REQUIRED, ORGANIZATION_DENIED, CUTOVER_REQUIRED, SOURCE_REQUIRED, WORKER_KIND_INVALID, SIGNOFF_INVALID, FILE_REQUIRED, FILE_TOO_LARGE, FILE_UNREADABLE, COLUMN_MISSING.

service.description: A batch compared now with what its sender signed off (PayrollExchange's Reconcile step), by its kind's permissions and employer: each ready or known row checked again (an export's input changed or taken since: INPUT_CHANGED; a history day recorded or paid since; results paid or in the period's run since), the totals (an export's amounts and quantities with its source keys; history's records, gross and net and each employee's a year; results' employees, gross, deductions, employer contributions and net and each employee's), the differences from the signed-off count and totals (expectedCount, expectedGross, expectedNet, which may be given again here), and for results the pay group's live reasons. Kept as the batch's reconciliation at a revision, which execute#Batch names. A batch done answers its reconciliation.

A reconciled batch done (PayrollExchange's CommitExchange step), by its kind's permissions and employer, at the revision reconciled (RECONCILE_STALE), with no difference from what was signed off (TOTALS_DIFFER) and a ready row (NOTHING_READY; NOT_RECONCILED before a reconciliation). An export: written through the export target payrollExchangeInputs (its record kept by the framework, listed in Admin's Exports) and stored with its manifest. History: each ready row in its own transaction a legacy pay record (EmploymentPayHistory, internal payroll N), checked again; no invoice or obligation. Results: refused for a group not in external processing (NOT_EXTERNAL), not live (NOT_LIVE, each reason) or before Accounting's payroll-origin projection (PROJECTION_PENDING), as finalization is; then the period's pay run of external results (made here, or the one an earlier batch made while not approved: RUN_EXISTS for a run calculated here, RUN_CLOSED for an approved one), each employee in their own transaction a calculated employment with the provider's lines and the period's approved inputs taken; the run is in review, asked, approved and finalized as any run. A failure is named and the rest go on. A batch done answers as it ended (repeated).

A batch a payroll reader of its employer reads (PAYROLL_VIEW; another is refused as missing, RECORD_UNAVAILABLE): its kind, scope, file, state, counts, signed-off totals, who made and did it and when, its reconciliation, what it made (a pay run, the export's record and, for a holder of its kind's permissions, its stored file and manifest), whether the user reconciles or does it now, and its rows (all, an outcome, or problems: refused and failed) with what each named and its outcome.
The latest 50 payroll exchanges of the employers a payroll reader reads (PAYROLL_VIEW), newest first, of a kind when asked (exchangeKind), each its kind, scope, file, state and counts.

The payroll history and results imports of the employers a payroll reader reads (PAYROLL_VIEW and People's scope; a scope key narrows), newest first, as summaries with the parameters that open each in PayrollExchange. None otherwise.

The pay inputs export's scopes: each prepared period, from about a year back to two months ahead, of the pay groups of the employers a payroll exporter (PAYROLL_VIEW and PAYROLL_EDIT) reads, as group:period. None otherwise.

A pay group's period's approved inputs (scopeKey group:period) as delimited text, or a payroll exchange export's rows (selection.batch), for a payroll exporter (PAYROLL_VIEW and PAYROLL_EDIT) of the group's employer: each its worker, name, employment, kind, component or input name, day, quantity and unit, amount, currency, rate and source key, the fields asked alone. rowCount alone with countOnly or past maxRows. Refused with a reason a person can act on: PERMISSION_DENIED, SCOPE_INVALID, BATCH_INVALID.
